source.title: CDC PLACES, 2025 release, census tract estimates
source.population: Mississippi adults aged 18 years and older. Adult population counts come from the 2020 Census.
source.period: 2023 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS), published in the 2025 PLACES release.
source.uncertainty: Each interval gives the original CDC model-based 95% confidence limits, in percent.
source.geography: 2023 Census tract GEOIDs joined to the Atlas 2024 TIGER/Line tract geography.

transportation_barrier_pct.label: Transportation barriers
transportation_barrier_pct.definition: Adults whose lack of reliable transportation prevented travel for work, appointments, meetings or daily needs in the previous 12 months.

food_insecurity_pct.label: Food insecurity
food_insecurity_pct.definition: Adults who sometimes, usually or always ran out of purchased food and lacked money for more in the previous 12 months.

housing_insecurity_pct.label: Housing insecurity
housing_insecurity_pct.definition: Adults unable to pay their rent, mortgage or a utility bill in the previous 12 months.

frequent_mental_distress_pct.label: Frequent mental distress
frequent_mental_distress_pct.definition: Adults who reported poor mental health on at least 14 of the previous 30 days.
